components.name: Headline
components.description: General Sans 500, tight tracking, plain punch.

narrative.northStar: The Partner's Letter, told in pictures
narrative.overview:
The pitch pages (/ and /recruiting) read like a letter from a partner at a serious firm. A strict 12-column grid, hairline rules, plain white paper, black ink. One sans, General Sans, does everything. No italics.

Most readers only look at headings and pictures, so the pictures carry the story: faces, an example thread in the first screen, a photo per half, a small code-drawn diagram under every step. Diagrams are always whole; motion brings things in as you scroll and never hides anything behind a click.

White screen, black text. The pfp's rust fills only the stamp, buttons, the guarantee seal and the back cover; marks elsewhere. No black blocks. Light only. No stock photos: image slots carry their Higgsfield prompt until the file exists.
keyCharacteristics: General Sans throughout, medium-weight headings with tight tracking. No italics.
The form sits in the first screen behind one black rule.
Pictures before paragraphs: faces, image slots, step diagrams.
Motion as a slideshow: things arrive as reached, sections dim as they leave.
The pfp as the logo; the page ends on a rust back cover like the banners.

rules.name: The Set Places Rule
rules.body: Rust fills exactly four things: the stamp, buttons, the guarantee seal and the back cover. Anything else rust is a dot, a line or a tag.

rules.name: The Plain Punch Rule
rules.body: A heading's `*punch*` renders plain: same ink, same style. No italic, no grey, no color.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or lines up uses lining tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: No shadows on anything that sits in the page.

dos: Do set everything in General Sans; headings 500 with tight tracking.
Do keep rust fills to the stamp, buttons, the seal and the back cover.
Do separate with 1px rules, not boxes.
Do keep question 1 in the first phone screen.
Do lead with a picture, a face or a diagram where a paragraph would go.
Do keep diagrams whole; motion only brings them in.
donts: Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't use cards, rounded corners, glow, gradients or glass.
Don't add a rust block beyond the seal and the back cover.
Don't use stock photos; generate from the slot's prompt.
Don't pin sections or hide content behind clicks.
